focus.description: Free text about what to put first, such as `error tracking` or `billing reports`. A request with focus always starts a new build, and an unfocused request never reuses it. Pass `wait_seconds` to wait for it.

limit.description: The most reports to return, best first. Defaults to 25. Values above the configured maximum (50) use the maximum.

refresh.description: Start a new build even when the stored one is current. The build runs in the background, so the response has `building: true`. Pass `wait_seconds` to wait for it.

wait_seconds.description: When the request starts a build or one is running, wait up to this many seconds for its list. Defaults to 0, which returns at once. A build usually takes 10 to 60 seconds.
